stops.name: Werbellinsee
stops.detail: During the ClimateChange education project, children on board the solar-powered research vessel Solar Explorer on Lake Werbellin explored the causes and consequences of global warming and developed their own solutions for climate protection together with regional climate mentors.

stops.name: Grumsin
stops.detail: Specialists from science, nature conservation and politics addressed these and other questions on September 16 and 17 on the occasion of the 15th anniversary of the UNESCO World Natural Heritage 'Ancient Beech Forests' in Eberswalde and in the Grumsin world heritage sub-area.

stops.name: Parsteinsee
stops.detail: NABU state chairman Björn Ellner led the appointment, during which experts at Lake Parstein and at the already dried-up Lake Wese explained the causes for the sinking water levels and possible approaches for action.
